_TEMPLATE_NOTICE: Copy this file to config/local_settings.json before use. Do not use template values directly in production.
_MODE_NOTICE: APP_ENV only supports local or production.
_DEPLOYMENT_NOTICE: Current default database is SQLite. Production deployment is single-instance only. Do not configure APP_SERVER_WORKERS or WEB_CONCURRENCY above 1 when still using SQLite.
_RUNTIME_ROOT_NOTICE: If APP_RUNTIME_ROOT is set, all relative runtime paths below will resolve under that root. This is the recommended way to prepare future persistent-volume mounts.
_PUBLIC_BASE_URL_NOTICE: PUBLIC_BASE_URL is optional for local use. In a server/domain environment it should be set to the external origin only, for example https://intel.example.com . Do not include path/query/fragment.
_PROXY_NOTICE: TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS must stay false unless the app is behind your own trusted reverse proxy. Do not blindly trust forwarded headers from unknown sources.
_FAIL_CLOSED_NOTICE: In production or server rehearsal mode, the app now fails closed. It will refuse to start if runtime paths are missing, if DATABASE_PATH is absent, or if the runtime database looks like an empty shell.
_SERVER_REHEARSAL_NOTICE: For server rehearsal, use APP_ENV=production and explicitly set APP_RUNTIME_ROOT or the key runtime paths. Do not rely on repository-relative fallback runtime creation.
